subject: maths
question: If total surface area of a cube is 726 cm². then what is the volume of cube?
solution:
**Given:**

Total surface area of the cube = 726 cm²

**Formula Used:**

Total surface area of cube = 6 × (side)²

Volume of cube = (side)³

**Calculation:**

Total surface area = 6 × (side)²

⇒ 726 = 6 × (side)²

⇒ (side)² = 726 / 6

⇒ (side)² = 121

⇒ side = √121

⇒ side = 11 cm

Volume of cube = (side)³

⇒ Volume = 11³

⇒ Volume = 1331 cm³

**The volume of the cube is 1331 cm³.**
